blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Agriculture (DA) in Mimaropa urged farmers to conserve water and manage soil properly to minimize crop losses as El Niño looms. READ: El Niño to bring drought to all provinces by March 2027 – DOST The call covers farmers in Occidental and Oriental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon and Palawan, particularly those relying on rain-fed farms or limited water sources. Maria Teresa B. Carido, DA Mimaropa development management officer, said early preparation would help farmers protect their crops and income. “Our advice from the DA is to prepare early so we can avoid losing income […]...
